name: The Clogfather
description: A colossal living fatberg of congealed grease, wet wipes, roots, and things nobody should have flushed. Wedged into the collection chamber beneath headquarters, it heaves against the pipework and spits the accumulated consequences back at anyone approaching.
implementation_status: Registered design and source artwork; no playable boss encounter
design_status: Giant fatberg identity approved; detailed anatomy, core appearance and combat tuning proposed

backstory.text: Billy-Joe classified repeated blockage warnings as duplicate reports and canceled the cleaning crews. Beneath headquarters, grease hardened around wipes, roots, and a buried outflow until the blockage filled the chamber. Then it began moving against the current. The Clogfather grew around something BJ's diagrams do not show. Removing it will restore access—but what it has been hiding may be worse than the clog.
backstory.canon_note: Proposed history, not approved canon. Portal origin and BJ prior knowledge remain open; no intentional summoning is established.

bar.setting: Boss bar visible by default, independent of ordinary-enemy bar toggle

health.rationale: 720 HP now requires 30 Sean plungers or 120 Tony pressure bolts. Sustained DPS is 24 versus 40; boss window/fight duration needs rebalancing after the starter-weapon nerf.
health.comparison_assumptions: Full damage against exposed weak point, no armor/upgrades/regeneration; all hits land. Counts do not include travel time, windup or overkill on summoned enemies.
health.duration_status: Unvalidated target; reassess after Sean damage drops to 24 and starting weapon ranges become 320/480 pixels.
health.status: Provisional design balance from Game Mechanics proposal; not implemented or playtested
health.runtime_note: No boss encounter or runtime spawn; metadata registration only.
health.comparison_notes: Only pressure gun and heavy plunger currently playable. Melee access requires low weak point; projectile accuracy and travel consume exposure time. Area attacks damage boss once per attack, never once per overlapping pipe. Counts exclude armor, misses, hazards, approach grace, and closed phases.

damage_art_status: Six static HP-stage source poses; attack variants and continuous collapse animation still need refinement
